name: Cham palm cake
summary: Bánh bò Chăm is a cake of palm sugar and coconut milk, each one cooked under a hot clay lid. It comes out soft inside with a light crisp crust, and it is best eaten warm.
origin: The Cham villages on the Hậu around Châu Đốc.
texture: Soft yet crisp, and best warm, straight from the fire.
howToEat: Eat it warm, soon after it leaves the lid.
Look for it when you visit the Cham villages.
where: Châu Phong and the Cham villages on the Hậu.
seoTitle: Banh bo Cham in Chau Doc
seoDescription: Bánh bò Chăm is a soft, lightly crisp palm-sugar and coconut cake cooked under a hot clay lid in the Cham villages near Châu Đốc.
